changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetDataProfile') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfile]( [ID] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AssetID] BIGINT NOT NULL, [ProfileSetDate] DATETIME NOT NULL, [ProfileIdentifier] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [SampleCount] BIGINT NULL, [NullCount] BIGINT NULL, [BlankCount] BIGINT NULL, [MeanValue] FLOAT NULL, [MinimumValue] NVARCHAR(500) NULL, [MaximumValue] NVARCHAR(500) NULL, [MinimumLength] INT NULL, [MaximumLength] INT NULL, [StandardDeviation] FLOAT NULL, [Multiline] BIT NULL, [RegExp] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, [Confidence] DECIMAL(28,4) NULL, [Type] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [TypeQualifier] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [LogicalType] BIT NULL, [LeadingWhiteSpace] BIT NULL, [LeadingZeroCount] INT NULL, [TrailingWhiteSpace] BIT NULL, [MatchCount] BIGINT NULL, [OutlierCardinality] INT NULL, [DataSignature] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [StructureSignature] NVARCHAR(200) NULL, [Cardinality] INT NULL, [ShapeCardinality] INT NULL, [TotalCount] BIGINT NULL, [OutlierCount] BIGINT NULL, [KeyConfidence] DECIMAL(5,4) NULL, [DetectionLocale] NVARCHAR(64) NULL, [FtaVersion] NVARCHAR(32) NULL, [DecimalSeparator] NCHAR(1) NULL, [UniqueCount] BIGINT NULL, [PopularityCount] BIGINT NULL, [IsAuthorizedForPopularity] BIT NULL, [SourceLastModified] DATETIME NULL, [FilterCount] BIGINT NULL, [Freshness] INT NULL, [CreatedBy] INT NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] DATETIME NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] INT NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] DATETIME NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetDataProfile_ID] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ([ID]), CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetDataProfile_Asset] FOREIGN KEY (AssetID) REFERENCES Asset(ID) ON DELETE CASCADE ) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[AssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'FilterCount') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfile] ADD [FilterCount] BIGINT NULL END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[AssetDataProfile]') AND name = 'Freshness') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfile] ADD [Freshness] INT NULL END

IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_ProfileSetDate') BEGIN CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_ProfileSetDate ON dbo.AssetDataProfile ([AssetID] ASC, [ProfileSetDate] ASC) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID ON dbo.AssetDataProfile ([AssetID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_Confidence') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_Confidence ON dbo.AssetDataProfile ([AssetID], [Confidence]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_TypeQualifier') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_TypeQualifier ON dbo.AssetDataProfile ([AssetID], [TypeQualifier]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_DataSignature') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_DataSignature ON dbo.AssetDataProfile ([AssetID], [DataSignature]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_StructureSignature') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_AssetDataProfile_AssetID_StructureSignature ON dbo.AssetDataProfile ([AssetID], [StructureSignature]) END
